title: Health of IVF Versus IVM Children (FM-BABIES)
brief_summary: The investigators conduct a follow up of our randomized controlled trial (RCT) to investigate the development of children born from In-vitro fertilization (IVF) and In-vitro maturation (IVM), in order to give strong evidence about the safety of IVM in women with high antral follicle count or especially polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All live babies born following the In-vitro Maturation and In-vitro fertilization from our FM study.
* Parents agree to participate in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Babies died under or at 24 months
study_population: Live babies born following the IVF and IVM from our FM study (NCT03405701)
